statements.quote: Data Center segment revenue was $3.2 billion, up 14% year-over-year primarily driven by strong demand for AMD EPYC™ processors more than offsetting headwinds impacting AMD Instinct MI308 shipments to China.
statements.notes: Second-quarter 2025 (quarter ended 2025-06-28) figure, not full year. Data Center segment includes EPYC server CPUs as well as Instinct AI accelerators. The same figure is repeated in p17, p18 and p20.

statements.quote: We are seeing robust demand across our computing and AI product portfolio and are well positioned to deliver significant growth in the second half of the year, driven by the ramp of our AMD Instinct MI350 series accelerators and ongoing EPYC and Ryzen processor share gains.
statements.notes: Qualitative outlook: second-half growth is attributed partly to the ramp of the AI accelerators. The sentence names no year ('second half of the year'), though context implies 2025. The growth driver mixes AI GPUs with CPU share gains.
